name: LLM Token Spend Circuit Breaker & Cost Allocator (Safe-by-Default)

parameters.content:
## LLM Token Spend Circuit Breaker & Cost Allocator

**Safe by default.** With no env vars this runs in **SANDBOX_MODE** on a synthetic fixture: provider responses are simulated, zero network calls, nothing posted, workflow static data untouched.

Live LLM calls need explicit opt-ins: `SANDBOX_MODE=false` · `DRY_RUN=false` · `LLM_CALLS_ENABLED=true` + `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in env. Cost alerts additionally need `ALERTS_ENABLED=true` + an allowlisted Slack / Teams webhook URL in env.

`CIRCUIT_BREAKER_ACTIVE_BY_DEFAULT=true` enforces hard / soft daily caps and provider breakers; over-budget, failing or unpriced requests degrade to deterministic fallback rules (regex, templates, rule scoring). Fail closed: untrusted ledger, config errors or unpriced models never reach a provider. Keys only via `$env`. See README.md.

nodes.name: LLM Gateway Webhook
nodes.notes: POST {"requests":[{request_id, task, provider, model, input, max_output_tokens, client_key, workflow_id, campaign_id, cost_center, priority}]} with header x-gateway-secret (required in live mode).

nodes.name: Daily Spend Digest (23:47)
nodes.notes: Daily digest at 23:47 in the instance time zone. Ships inactive.

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Env-only config, fail-safe flags, budgets (integer nano-USD), pricing table, provider allowlist, fallback rules, alert allowlist, webhook auth.

nodes.name: Request Intake & Validation
nodes.notes: Validates and normalises requests; manual runs use the embedded synthetic fixture.

nodes.name: Load Spend Ledger
nodes.notes: Daily ledger from static data (fixture seed in sandbox); fail closed on corruption; day rollover; breaker cooldowns.

nodes.name: Circuit Breaker & Router
nodes.notes: Worst-case pre-flight estimate, provider breakers, per-request ceiling, hard caps (trip), soft caps (downgrade).

nodes.name: Expand LLM Calls
nodes.notes: One item per provider call; optional PII redaction. Keys are added by the HTTP node from $env.

nodes.name: Simulated Provider Response
nodes.notes: SANDBOX only: deterministic provider responses (success, 429, 529, timeout, quota exhausted, missing usage).

nodes.name: Call LLM Provider
nodes.notes: Keys from $env only. No auto-retry (each retry costs tokens): failures degrade to fallback rules and feed the provider breaker.

nodes.name: Parse Usage & Cost
nodes.notes: Validated token usage, exact integer cost, error classification (timeout, 429, 529, quota).

nodes.name: Fallback Rules & Cost Allocation
nodes.notes: Deterministic fallbacks + attribution to client / workflow / campaign / cost center (exact shared split).

nodes.name: Commit Spend Ledger
nodes.notes: Applies spend, trips and breaker transitions; persists only in live non-dry-run runs.

nodes.name: Cost Alert Builder
nodes.notes: Slack Block Kit + Teams Adaptive Card; one alert per event per budget day.

nodes.name: Post Slack / Teams Alert
nodes.notes: Webhook URLs read from $env only. No automatic retry (no duplicate alerts).
